med-jour-01-c1.text: Paul Hond (2020). The First Pulitzer Prize. Columbia Magazine, Columbia University.
med-jour-01-c1.quote: He gave Columbia $2 million to start the nation's first graduate journalism school, which opened in 1912
med-jour-01-c1.claim: the first journalism schools (Columbia's, founded 1912 by an endowment from Joseph Pulitzer)
